fields.summary_ko.0: Samsung Electronics closed at KRW 232,000 on October 29, a 38% decline from its June high of KRW 374,500, with analyst target prices ranging from KRW 270,000 to KRW 670,000, a variance of up to 2.5x or more.
fields.summary_ko.1: In Q3 2026 earnings, Samsung recorded revenue of KRW 195.2532 trillion (+126.9%), operating profit of KRW 107.4405 trillion (+783.1%), and operating margin of 55.0%, with quarterly operating profit exceeding KRW 100 trillion for the first time.
fields.summary_ko.2: The primary source of target price divergence stems from differing expectations regarding the pace of entry into high-value-added AI memory such as HBM4, with bullish forecasts of prolonged memory supply shortages opposed by conservative concerns about softening demand.
